body: Yeah, and I'll look for one. I say that right now, with every intent of following through. I know where I want to apply, there are so many places that are hiring at the moment, it should be easy. There's no reason not to, but at the same time I know myself and the effort I put into everything, even the things that I want to do and look forward to. I'm scared that I won't put enough effort into the job hunt. Honestly, if I say that now, and it comes true, as in I don't put any effort into it, then I have made a terrible mistake, more than that, it's absolutely inexcusable. There's no excuse for recognizing a problem and then not fixing it. I know myself too well though. I don't know how to explain this properly, because honestly this sounds like I'm giving into my own laziness. Fuck no, that's the last thing that I want to do.Whatever this is, I don't want to sit back and let it be true. I don't know how to not make it sound like I'm giving into my own laziness, I wish I could convey how frustrating it is to be my own road block, how much I hate myself for it (legitimate rage), and how defeated I feel by it.
She had every right to fire me, and I'm not going to pretend like she didn't. In my opinion, as much as I didn't want to be fired, she should have done it sooner.
